title: Equipment Handling: Stow and Secure Tools

steps.hint: Look at the panel ahead of you, labelled TOOL STOWAGE. Every loose tool is stowed here so it cannot drift.
The orange TORQUE WRENCH floats on your left. In microgravity a released tool drifts away until you stow it.

steps.instruction: Place the TORQUE WRENCH in BAY 1.
steps.hint: BAY 1 is the left socket on the TOOL STOWAGE panel. Check the tool seats fully; each bay accepts only its own tool.
The BAY 1 LATCH toggle is below BAY 1. Check its label shows ON; a latch stops the tool floating out.
The INSPECTION SCANNER floats on your right. Check BAY 1 is latched first; finish one tool before starting the next.

steps.instruction: Place the INSPECTION SCANNER in BAY 2.
steps.hint: BAY 2 is the right socket on the TOOL STOWAGE panel. Only the scanner fits; any other tool is rejected and drifts free.
The BAY 2 LATCH toggle is below BAY 2. Check both latch labels show ON so neither tool can float out.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT to confirm all tools are stowed.
steps.hint: REPORT is on the STATUS panel on your right. Confirm both tools are stowed and latched first; mission control relies on this report.
